runtime: HTML and CSS; native browser behavior only

components.name: Button
components.behavior: Native buttons, links and authored pressed states. Consumers own actual toggle state changes. Disabled buttons use native disabled; unavailable links omit href and use aria-disabled. No browser JavaScript ships.

deprecatedVariants.plan: Use spread/full; event composition owns its action gap.

components.name: Icon button
components.behavior: Native buttons, links and authored pressed states. Consumers own actual toggle state changes. Disabled buttons use native disabled; unavailable links omit href and use aria-disabled. No browser JavaScript ships.

deprecatedVariants.focus-sample: Display-only compatibility alias. Demonstrate real focus-visible instead.

components.name: Field
components.behavior: Native typing, supported readonly/disabled semantics and constraint validation. Authored errors preserve hints/values; consumers render reviewed messages and aria-invalid together.

components.name: Native choice
components.behavior: Visible native checkbox/radio inside its label. Native checked, required, keyboard and disabled/fieldset semantics; no simulated choice engine.

components.name: Filter chip
components.behavior: Native checkbox/radio label or navigation anchor. Native checked state supplies selection. Authored selected compatibility is appearance only; unavailable links omit href. Disabled appearance wins over selection/errors.

components.name: Badge
components.behavior: Noninteractive authored status text. No button, toggle, hover, disabled or automatic live-region semantics.

components.name: Notice
components.behavior: Persistent authored explanation with uniform neutral borders. Error/success modifiers remain compatible labels with the same shell. Consumers own actual validation, focus, insertion and announcements.

components.name: Toast specimen
components.behavior: Static authored message specimen and optional native link. No saving, timing, queue, dismissal, automatic focus or live-region engine ships. Legacy direct span/anchor markup remains supported.

components.name: Organizer
components.behavior: Static contact information with native links; consumers supply truthful identity and contact destinations.

components.name: Sponsored placement
components.behavior: Static sponsorship with persistent explicit wording; no simulated selection, dismissal or tracking behavior.

components.behavior: Native sibling covering link and optional independent action; no nested controls or simulated article button. Host renders actual preview/status/availability. Kit owns type/spacing; only declared preview visibility/outline exceptions remain consumer-owned.

deprecatedElements.separator: Legacy decorative metadata node remains valid but hidden; fixed gaps avoid orphan divider lines when wrapping.

components.name: Prominent date
components.behavior: Known dates use native time plus a full accessible label; decorative fragments are aria-hidden. Unknown dates are ordinary text, never fabricated datetime values.

components.name: Empty state
components.behavior: Authored absent-content explanation and appropriate next step. Heading-level-independent title; legacy h2/p markup remains supported. Consumers render actual result state; no matching or persistence engine ships.

components.name: Missing photo
components.behavior: Text alternative when no event image is available; no decorative empty image or fabricated alt text.

components.name: File field
components.behavior: Native chooser, selection/replacement and form reset. Accept is a chooser hint. Consumer-rendered errors and file-content/size validation are separate; no upload engine or browser JavaScript ships.

components.name: Photographic event opening
components.behavior: Photographic reading context with native links and semantic facts. Kit owns internal rhythm; consumer exceptions cover safe-area, viewport, crop protection and print placement only.

consumerStyleExceptions.reason: Host viewport reserve and print flow; no change to component type or internal rhythm.
Native safe-area clearance and print omission of navigation.

components.name: Expandable disclosure
components.behavior: Native details/summary. Enter or Space toggles; Tab reaches revealed controls. Do not simulate aria-expanded or duplicate the native role.

components.name: Calendar event group
components.behavior: Authored labelled groups with native fragments and 44px jump targets. Consumers own counts, hidden state and scrolling ancestors; sticky offset is an explicit CSS input. No calendar navigation script ships.

components.name: Event details
components.behavior: Semantic headings, paragraphs, lists and native fragments. Consumers supply content, heading levels and IDs; documented exceptions cover reading measure, safe-area and fragment clearance.

consumerStyleExceptions.reason: Consumer reading measure in a wide detail document.
Native fragment clearance in the host document.

components.name: Prose
components.behavior: Native HTML. Host owns a valid heading outline, safe rich HTML, meaningful links, alt text and table headers. Wide scroll regions have visible captions, accessible names and keyboard access.

components.name: Additive panel
components.behavior: Additive extension stylesheet, loaded explicitly. Theme-aware static panel and native links; no behavior engine.

components.name: Filter panel
components.behavior: HTML/CSS shell only. Host owns one combined form, matching/validation, dialog snapshot and focus, GET routing, breakpoint placement and available height.

components.name: Venue profile
components.behavior: Heading, address/contact, access information, actions and event-specific guidance. Consumers own sticky/scroll placement; retain profile information for empty schedules and filtered zero matches.

components.name: Venue card
components.behavior: Native heading link, description, place and accurate schedule wording. No nested interactive links or invented access facts.

components.name: Site header
components.behavior: Native nav/list/link composition that wraps without a menu script. One aria-current=page link only when it identifies this page. Skip link and main target supplied by the page.

components.name: Form error summary
components.behavior: Compose with Notice. This static specimen does not compute, reveal or clear errors. A consumer-rendered summary retains values/hints and exposes invalid fields; the consumer owns summary focus and announcements.

tide-content-page.behavior: Optional native contents links sit above the body on small screens and alongside it on wide screens. Sticky only with sufficient viewport height. Host supplies routes, heading IDs, updated date, and public footer destinations.

tide-results.behavior: Explicit count and order typography. Consumer supplies truthful singular/plural counts; static specimens are not live regions or sorting controls. Dynamic announcements belong to the consumer. The utility variant promotes the count to a 20px heading and moves the separator below the row; default Results presentation is unchanged.
